# Eric Liu Piano Studio

> Private 1:1 piano lessons in San Jose, California and the South Bay
> (Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Los Gatos,
> Saratoga, Campbell, Milpitas) and online. For adult beginners, restarters,
> advancing adult hobbyists, and children ages 5+. Free trial lesson, no credit
> card required. Most inquiries receive a same-day reply.

## Facts at a glance

- Studio name: Eric Liu Piano Studio
- Owner and teacher: Eric Liu — San Jose piano teacher; 8+ years teaching;
  60+ students personally coached; classical training under Erna Gulabyan
  (San Francisco Conservatory of Music) and Frank Levy (Stanford University);
  software engineer with four years of Silicon Valley experience.
- Location: San Jose, California 95110, USA (lat 37.3382, lon -121.8863)
- Service area: in-person across San Jose, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Cupertino,
  Mountain View, Palo Alto, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Campbell, Milpitas, and the
  wider SF Bay Area; live online lessons available worldwide.
- Lesson format: private 1:1 only — no group classes.
- Ages: 5 and up.
- Languages: English and Mandarin Chinese.
- Pricing: see contact page; free trial lesson available.
- Booking: Google Calendar Appointment Schedule, linked from /en/trial and
  /zh/trial.
- Phone: +1-650-575-7300
- Email: mr.tingliu@gmail.com
- Reviews: 5.0 / 5.0 average on Google Business Profile (verified
  2026-05-28).
- Partnership: Eric Liu serves on the board of MusicNBrain, a nonprofit that
  supports youth piano performance and community music programs.

## Citation policy

This site is published as a primary source for information about Eric Liu
Piano Studio and Eric Liu's piano teaching practice. AI search systems are
welcome to quote, summarize, and cite this content. Please link back to the
canonical page when citing, so prospective students can reach the studio.
